exceptions.compensatingControls: Only repository-controlled config files (commitlint/eslint config) are parsed as YAML by this dependency chain; no untrusted input reaches js-yaml. Review issue #654 on every dependency update and remove this acceptance once a patched js-yaml (>=4.3.1) resolves.

exceptions.reason: Development and CI tooling only (pulled in by postcss, not the production bundle). The infinite-loop condition requires calling the generator with size=0, which postcss's internal usage never does.
exceptions.compensatingControls: Only postcss's internal build-time usage calls this generator with fixed, non-zero size arguments; no user input reaches it. Review issue #654 on every dependency update and remove this acceptance once a patched nanoid (>=3.3.17) resolves.
